signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Welcome back. Pick up where you left off.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lead: Free, and built for students. Your notes stay private until you choose otherwise.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid passwords you use elsewhere.
signUp.dobHint: Only used for age rules; never shown to anyone.
signUp.institutionalHint: We send it a code to verify you. Without one, a teacher or our team can verify you later.
signUp.terms: I accept the Terms, the Privacy Policy and the licence for content I make public.

details.title: A few details
details.lead: We need these once, then you are in.

providers.failed: That sign-in did not work. Try again.

verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
verify.pendingReview: Your address is confirmed. Our team reviews new organisations; you will be verified once it is approved.
verify.signInFirst: Sign in to enter the code we sent to your college email.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a link.
reset.sent: If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way. It works for 60 minutes.
reset.done: Your password is changed and every device was signed out. Sign in with the new one.

callback.failed: That sign-in could not be completed. Start again from the sign-in page.
